title: A Oath for the Thorn
author: Juniper Marchetti
blurb: Zephyrine Sandoval, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
